arguments.text: Implemented evaluate(request, policy) in work.py: deduplicates declared paths, excludes policy.ignored, compares canonical full JSON saved/current states, treats absent entries as {kind:missing}, returns sorted changed paths and needs_review, and does not mutate inputs. report.json contains the computed result for current requests.json/policy.json. Local checks cover key-order equivalence, duplicates, ignored paths, missing-state equivalence, complete-state differences, sorting, irrelevant undeclared changes, and input immutability.
